name: Waypoint REIT
summary: Waypoint REIT is Australia's largest listed REIT owning solely fuel and convenience retail properties, with a high-quality portfolio of 394 assets across Australia as at 30 June 2026. Waypoint REIT's objective is to maximise the long-term returns from the portfolio for the benefit of all securityholders. Waypoint REIT is a stapled entity in which one share in Waypoint REIT Limited is stapled to one unit in the Waypoint REIT Trust. This ASX announcement is prepared for information purposes only and is correct at the time of release to the ASX. Factual circumstances may change following the release of this announcement.
